| shape | union median | vLLM median | union / vLLM | K/V reuse | union logical hot bytes |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| c1, 300 overlap | 5.32698 ms | 0.878752 ms | 6.061x | 49.976% | 321,335,400 B |
| c1, 300 disjoint | 10.2357 ms | | | 0% | 637,445,400 B |
| c1, 8192 causal | 110.721 ms | 16.035200 ms | 6.905x | 49.976% | 7,689,308,156 B |

The first launch deadlocked because thread 0 alone advanced thread-local merge cursors. Commit `3c2789e` moves cursor and termination state into CTA shared memory. The unchanged rerun produced the table. Diagnostic counters ran once outside every timed and captured sample.

The union halved selected K/V traffic. Six CTA barriers per 16-token union tile and the custom WMMA schedule left the 300-token path at 60.32 GB/s of logical traffic. The measured vLLM control remained 6.061x faster.

**Verdict.** Rejected on value. The fixed query-pair union loses at both workload anchors despite exact immutable-state hashes, deterministic graph replay, and bounded BF16 output error. This is a QSA sparse-attention substage result. It does not measure whole prefill.

**Next.**

- Hard-cut the production target to a fixed-shape fork of FlashInfer `sparse_prefill_sm12x.py`.
- Remove general dispatch and index work for Hq12/Hkv1/D256/top-k2051.
- Measure c1, c2, c4, c8, and c16 at 300 and 8192 tokens.

**Reopen if.**

- A newer SM121 FlashInfer or compiler release changes the query-pair union schedule.
